module: Flowgraph node "Add To Inventory" (category once_instant, career color/icon). Adds the vehicle with the given id to the player's inventory via career_modules_inventory.addVehicle. Input: vehId (number). Sets a node error if the career module is not loaded or if no id is given. Copies the input flow to the output.
notes: The inventory module exists only in career mode.

workOnce.desc: Adds the vehicle to the inventory or reports an error, then copies flow to the output.
